content:
UPSSSC Cane Supervisor Online Form 2026 – Link Active

  • Start Date : 07 July 2026
  • Last Date : 28 July 2026
  • Total : 1182 Posts
  • Syllabus & Exam Pattern : Available

Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has invited online applications for Cane Supervisor (Ganna Paryavekshak) under Advertisement 13-Exam/2026 – total 1,182 posts.

अंतिम तिथि 28 July 2026 नजदीक है – eligible candidates जल्दी Apply करें।

Important Dates

  • Application Begin : 07 July 2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online / Fee : 28 July 2026
  • Correction / Fee Reconciliation : till about 04 August 2026
  • Exam Date : As per UPSSSC schedule
  • Admit Card : Before exam

Eligibility (summary)

  • Education : B.Sc. Agriculture / Horticulture / Forestry or B.Tech Agriculture (or equivalent as in notification)
  • Computer : CCC certificate from NIELIT (or as prescribed)
  • PET : Must have appeared in UPSSSC PET 2025 with valid non-zero score
  • Age : generally 21–40 years with relaxations

Syllabus & Exam Pattern

Official / detailed Syllabus and Exam Pattern are available with the recruitment notice. Candidates should prepare as per UPSSSC Cane Supervisor written exam scheme (subject + general awareness / agriculture related topics as notified).

Selection Process

Written Exam → Document Verification → Final Selection as per UPSSSC rules.

How to Apply

  1. Open https://upsssc.gov.in
  2. Login / complete OTR
  3. Open Cane Supervisor 2026 Apply Online (Link Active)
  4. Fill form, upload documents, pay fee
  5. Submit before 28 July 2026
  6. Save printout of application

Apply only on official UPSSSC website. Read full notification for post-wise eligibility, fee and syllabus before applying.
